turns.message: In Snowflake, what happens if I insert 12.345 into a NUMBER(38,0) column?

outputs.reference_answer: Snowflake silently rounds the value to 12: NUMBER(38,0) has scale 0 so every decimal place is dropped without an error. Declare an explicit scale such as NUMBER(38,2) for money, and validate with a SUM/value reconciliation because row counts will still match.

turns.message: Should I validate my migration by running one dbt build over the whole project?

outputs.reference_answer: No. A whole-project dbt build rebuilds unrelated models, costs warehouse time, and a failing test skips everything downstream so the picture is incomplete. Stage it: dbt compile --select the model, dbt build --select the model, then the model plus downstream (model+) with --defer --state against production artifacts, and state:modified+ in CI; recommend but never claim to run these.

turns.message: When should I use IFNULL versus NULLIF in a dbt model?

outputs.reference_answer: Use IFNULL(field, default) to replace NULLs with a default value (often IFNULL(TRIM(field), 'NA') for strings). Use NULLIF(field, value) only to turn a specific value into NULL, for example NULLIF(field, '') to turn empty strings into NULL.
